text:
Type: striped wool blend area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: wool blend, hand-tufted textured pile
Colors: light grey, charcoal
Shape: rectangular, angled panels of slanted lines meeting in chevron-like blocks, raised looped texture, medium size, plain edges
Feel: graphic, calm, textured
Goes with: cognac leather, dark wood floors, black accents; modern or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Wool Blend Area Rug, 4' x 6', Grey Charcoal
product.description: Add energy to your home décor with this striking gray-and-charcoal rug. Its bold reimagining of the classic stripe pattern makes it ideal for a transitional-style room, and its high-height pile works well in any indoor space. 4'W x 6'L Imported. 80% wool, 20% cotton Hand-tufted geometric pattern with variable pile High .6" pile suits any indoor space Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
